hypotheses.justification: Split on whether buCutScalar κ z is nonnegative. In the nonnegative case, use the supplied proof. Otherwise the left side is nonpositive, while the right side is nonnegative by hM and nonnegativity of square roots and vec3EuclideanNorm. Zero cutoff values and vanishing gradients are covered.

The remaining hypothesis hderiv implies 0 ≤ |spatialPartial (buCutScalar κ) (0 : Fin 3) z| ≤ M. Derive hM from this and use the existing proof unchanged. Fin 3 has the index 0, so there is no empty-index exception; zero derivatives also give the required bound.
